PUT /foo
body contains PUT /foo

PATCH /foo
body contains PATCH /foo

DELETE /foo
body contains DELETE /foo

PATCH /echo
postbody q=x
reqcookie custom-cookie xyz
body contains "q": ["x"]
cookie custom-cookie == xyz

PUT /echo
postbody q=y
reqcookie custom-cookie xyz
body contains "q": ["y"]
rawcookie custom-cookie == custom-cookie=xyz; Path=/; Max-Age=30

DELETE /echo
body contains no query
